articles.title: Zelensky reiterates call for Ukraine's NATO membership: It will make us all stronger
articles.summary: President Zelensky emphasized Ukraine's unique defense capabilities from modern warfare and argued that NATO membership would strengthen the Alliance's collective defense.

articles.title: Zelensky discusses needs for urgent air defense missiles delivery with Rutte
articles.summary: President Zelensky met with NATO Secretary General Mark Rutte during the NATO summit in Ankara to discuss urgent delivery of air defense missiles and contributions to the PURL program.

articles.title: Ukraine working to secure additional air defense systems and missiles – Zelensky
articles.summary: President Zelensky stated that Ukraine is continuing daily work to secure additional air defense systems and missiles, with particular priority on Patriot missiles.
